title: Primero
bettingNotice: Your turn — call, raise (vie), or fold.

handLegend.title: Hand ranking (strongest first)
handLegend.fluxus: All four cards of one suit. Compared by prime-point total.
handLegend.supremus: One card of each suit (Primero) with a point total of 50 or more. Compared by total.
handLegend.primero: One card of each suit, point total below 50. Compared by total.
handLegend.numerus: None of the above. Compared by the total of the strongest single suit.
handLegend.pointsNote: Prime points: 7=21, 6=18, A=16, 5=15, 4=14, 3=13, 2=12, face=10 (8, 9, 10 are removed from the 40-card deck).

tutorial.info: This shows the round number, pot, ante, current bet, and each player's chips and status. Primero is a Renaissance (16th-century) 4-card vying pot game and an ancestor of poker.
tutorial.hand: Your four cards. Hands rank (low to high): Numerus, Primero (one card of each suit), Supremus, and Fluxus (four of a suit); the strongest hand takes the pot.
tutorial.actions: Call to match the current bet, raise (vie) to increase it, or fold to sit out the round. When betting ends the hands are compared to decide the pot.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game and start over.
